metadata.title: Why Yardeni sees the AI selloff as a buying opportunity

content.text:
Investing.com -- Yardeni Research said in its latest note that the recent selloff in AI-related stocks is a buying opportunity, arguing that obstacles to the AI buildout will slow it but not stop it.
The firm believes Anthropic's record stock market debut on Thursday showed that enthusiasm for AI remains strong, even as broader market sentiment has soured. The S&P 500 fell 2%, and the Nasdaq dropped 2.2% on the day.
Yardeni noted that the selloff extended to chip stocks, with AMD falling 7.7% after a short-seller report raised concerns about its ties to Chinese entities. Coming after the Nvidia controversy and tighter U.S. export controls, the firm called it another reminder of the political speed bumps facing the AI trade.
However, the firm has argued that financial, political and physical constraints may slow the AI buildout but are unlikely to halt it as long as demand for computing power keeps growing. It added that Anthropic's future earnings reports will offer a clearer view of AI adoption across the economy.
"We believe it is and continue to view the recent selloff as a buying opportunity," Yardeni wrote, referring to whether compute demand is strong enough to sustain the buildout.
The firm kept its S&P 500 target of 7,900, based on 2027 EPS of $425 and a forward P/E of 18.6. It highlighted that Wall Street analysts keep raising their estimates, with the 2028 consensus at $496 versus Yardeni's $450.
"We suspect some irrational exuberance, as these forecasts fail to account for the AI buildout's speed bumps," the firm said. "We think that panic selling should abate soon."
